meta.name: LME-Bench
meta.description: Long-horizon Multi-turn image Editing benchmark: 100 ten-turn editing sessions. Each session starts from a 1024x1024 source image (images/<id>.png, generated by Z-Image-Turbo from source_prompt); every turn edits the previous turn's output. labels mark each turn as a hard global edit (style / grade / atmosphere), a soft global edit (color temperature / tone) or a local edit.
